layouts.name: Bucks_Estate_Combo
layouts.description: Combined mapped configurations: Industrial estate full, Lenborough Road return. Shared sections count once in the mapped branch length. Branch identity and historical alignment still need review.

layouts.name: Industrial estate full
layouts.description: Complete connected road configuration through Osier Way, the southern bypass roundabout, A421, Great Slade, Middle Slade and Top Angel. The council identifies the estate road network; exact public road nodes retain historical alignment and lane-choice limits. This draft is a supplied road-test configuration, not an asserted licensed racing venue.

layouts.name: Lenborough Road return
layouts.description: The supplied Combo configuration identifies the inner Lenborough Road return between the A421 and Osier Way. Exact public OSM nodes retain this historical estate-road alternative as a separate closed course. The council describes Lenborough Road and the estate network; its present footway classification and historic vehicle-use correspondence remain explicit draft limitations. No private diagram coordinates are imported.
